subject.title: ACP session identity stuck in "pending" state after gateway restart storm, causing messages to be unrouted to bound ACP agent

question: Should ACP restart recovery be fixed through a status/liveness-backed re-ensure or warm-restore path while keeping ensure-sourced IDs provisional, instead of changing pending identities with stable IDs to resolved immediately?
rationale: The bug is credible and user-facing, but the safest persisted identity contract and interaction with the blocked warm-restore PR need maintainer intent before automation changes ACP session semantics.

options.title: Status-backed recovery
options.body: Keep ensure IDs provisional, add or repair a persistent-session recovery path that probes or recreates live runtime state, and require channel restart proof.

options.title: Resolve pending stable IDs
options.body: Treat pending identities with stable IDs as resolved immediately, accepting the risk that stale ensure IDs become authoritative before status/event confirmation.

options.title: Wait for warm-restore PR
options.body: Defer this issue until the open warm-restore/PID-liveness PR is repaired, rebased, proven, and then evaluated for full coverage.

recommendation.title: Status-backed recovery
recommendation.body: Keep ensure IDs provisional, add or repair a persistent-session recovery path that probes or recreates live runtime state, and require channel restart proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on ACP control-plane extraction, runtime-handle ensure, runtime-resume state, and ACP identity semantics.
